About 110 source variants across several agents (2026-10-06..09): if/else and early-return shapes, result variable, inline helper with its own cleanup, int/unsigned/long size and align types, C vs C++, callee return types, branch order; with the default, -fno-optimize-sibling-calls, -fno-strict-aliasing+nosib profiles and ee-gcc 2.9-991111. Without nosib gcc turns both calls into sibling jumps; with nosib align is copied to v1 and size to a3 (original: size in v1). 2.9-991111 gets size into v1 but rematerialises 4 and moves align early. Do not try more of these; only a genuinely new source shape (e.g. the call inside a destructor-carrying scope, a different caller-visible prototype) or a permuter run is worth it.
